subject: Weekly forecast submission & Friday commit review
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 09 Mar 2026 15:17:00 -0700
Subject: Weekly forecast submission & Friday commit review

Team —

Quick reminder: the weekly forecast is due by EOD Thursday. Please drop your updated rows into the shared Forecast_Template_Q2_v3.xlsx (link below) and flag any deals that you expect to move this week in the "commit" or "late commit" buckets.

Why this matters: finance will pull the consolidated forecast Friday morning for the leadership commit review, and the CS/renewals team will use the same view to prioritize outreach. If your commit amount is soft, add a short note in the "risk_notes" column so we can triage on Friday.

Agenda for Friday's 30-min commit review (11:00–11:30 PT):
- Quick roll-up (2 min) — revenue ops
- Top 6 commits: owners & short risks (3 min each)
- Any redlines/contract timing that will affect close (5 min)
- Ask from finance: confirmation on ACME deal structure and renewal date
- Action items & owners (last 3 min)

Attachments: Forecast_Template_Q2_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet) — please use this file, same tabs as last quarter. I'll attach the Friday agenda tomorrow morning.

Link: https://drive.redwood.ai/teams/sales/Forecasts/Q2_Forecast

If you can't make the deadline, ping me and why — helps prioritize follow-up.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Weekly forecast submission & Friday commit review

Thanks Lauren — will update by EOD Thursday. Two quick clarifications:

1) Pipeline stage mapping: are we using the updated mapping ("late commit" = verbal + pricing agreed but waiting on PO) or the legacy definitions? Wanted to be sure ACME (D-4921) sits in the right bucket.

2) For deals >$100k, do you want the contract timeline column filled with expected PO/Sign dates, or is a short note in risk_notes sufficient?

Folks —

Thanks for the quick turn. Final reminders and a short agenda for Friday's commit review. I've looped in Maria from ACME and the ACME finance alias so we can align on the procurement timing for D-4921 during the call if needed.

1) Please ensure your rows in Forecast_Template_Q2_v3.xlsx are updated by EOD Thursday.
2) If you volunteered a slide (Stephanie — ACME + two other deals), please add to the shared folder under /Presentations by Thursday 17:00 PT.

   - 11:12 ACME procurement status (Lauren & Maria) — confirm expected PO date
   - 11:18 Finance asks: revenue recognition / billing timing (Finance rep)
   - 11:24 Actions & owners; confirm post-call owners for any blockers

Attachments: FRI_commit_agenda.md (agenda) and Forecast_Template_Q2_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet).
